caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded stoneware jar with a narrow neck and two lug handles near the top on opposite sides. The jar is primarily gray in color with some subtle brownish discoloration visible on its surface. The neck of the jar features the inscription “N. CLARK & CO.” in black uppercase letters, and below this, the word “LYONS” can be seen, also in uppercase but smaller letters. The front of the jar displays a prominent cobalt blue painted bird with stylized wings and tail feathers, and blue brushstrokes are also visible around the handles and on the body of the jar. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white color, and the artist’s signature “John Turranting” appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
